operations.title: Entry 1151 separates the three mod-two phenomena at the generic integral-lattice level
operations.body: Entry 1151 is verified. The degree-two del Pezzo anticanonical class 3H-sum Ei is primitive, so integral localization gives 0 -> Z7 -> H2(U;Z) -> Z2(-1) -> 0. Hence the enhanced/conductor (Z/2)^2, cyclic pair-forgetting (Z/2)^3, and elliptic width-two Z/2 cannot be identified as torsion of the generic rank-nine lattice. Any interaction must come from integral off-diagonal monodromy or supported nearby cycles. Next frontier: compute coinvariants of the full integral Gysin extension at E_T=0, not just diagonal blocks.

authority_basis.summary: Coordinate the integral cosmology frontier with marici.Nima.
